global.sourceText: Completion of one of the following with a weighted average mark of at least 65%: An undergraduate degree in public health OR An undergraduate degree and at least two years appropriate full-time work experience (or equivalent) in a public health setting (health policy, health economics, health planning, epidemiology research, etc.) OR An undergraduate degree and at least two years appropriate full-time work experience (or equivalent) in a professional healthcare setting (medical, nursing, AHPRA-registered allied health) OR A masters degree (by research or coursework) or PhD in health or public health.
English language requirements: IELTS: 6.5 (no band less than 6.0); TOEFL: 81 (W19, S19, R16, L16); Pearson: 64 (no skill below 60); Cambridge C1 Advanced: 169; LanguageCert Academic: 67; MET: 58.
